Height: the highest point is 56 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front facade, eye level: loggia, central pediment and green dome behind, gilded statues at the corners, blue sky
  2. elevated rooftop view of the stage-house gable and side wing with the Eiffel Tower in the distance, clear sky
  3. elevated rooftop view of the great stage house and the green dome at left, overcast

Reply with the JSON object only.
